provenance.description: Evaluate hydration seam placement options for a future context architecture and recommend one direction.

intent.outcome: Evaluate three design options for where a future kernel + stable baseline + task working set + archive retrieval context system should attach to the BWP family, score each against integration cost, authority preservation, and evidence quality, and recommend one direction with a rationale.

sufficiency.rationale: Decision question, evaluation criteria, and deliverable form are explicit; deliberate analysis is required.

criteria: All three options scored against the stated criteria
Recommendation names the chosen seam and the rejected alternatives with reasons
No implementation or schema changes performed
